title: COSHUMA full affiliate program audit for all registered tools

payload.goal: Audit EVERY currently registered COSHUMA tool and identify every legitimate zero-cost affiliate/referral/partner monetization path so the full catalog can be monetized wherever such a program exists.
requirements: Read the current main-branch tool dataset first and derive the exact current tool count and IDs; do not assume 151 if main differs.

For EVERY registered tool without exception, search official sources first for affiliate/referral/partner programs. Record official source URL/evidence, program status, network/provider, commission model, cookie duration, payout threshold/method if public, application URL, country/eligibility restrictions, maintenance requirements, and whether joining is free.
Classify each tool as approved_tracking, applied_pending, rejected, blocked_platform_bug, program_exists_not_applied, no_program_found, program_closed, or needs_manual_verification.
Never count a generic homepage/pricing/signup URL as an affiliate link.
Preserve known verified states for Taskade, Systeme.io, Fliki and current pending/rejected/blocked programs unless fresher official evidence changes them.
Prioritize ordering by expected monetization value, but DO NOT stop at a top-N list. Produce an actionable queue covering every tool for which a legitimate program exists.
Return a complete per-tool structured inventory plus an ordered application queue containing ALL eligible not-yet-applied programs.
Zero cost only; no paid tools; no production writes; no account applications in this research task.
